annotations.title: Buy a mobile proxy with USDC (spends real money)

description: SPENDS REAL MONEY from the caller's own wallet: USDC on Base, paid over x402, $1.00 to $500.00 per purchase. Not refundable on chain. Rents one dedicated mobile proxy for 1 or 30 days with no ipvolt account, API key or order set up first. Three calls. (1) Without a receipt and without a payment: nothing is charged or created; the answer is a quote with the exact price and a receipt. SAVE THE RECEIPT BEFORE PAYING: it is a secret, and the only way to what you pay for. (2) After the user approved that charge, the same call with the argument receipt: the answer is an x402 payment request, or, if this receipt was already paid, what became of the purchase. (3) The same call, receipt included, with the x402 payment in params._meta["x402/payment"]; an x402 client makes this call by itself. One payment per receipt: repeating a call with its receipt never charges twice. If an answer is lost, repeat the call with the receipt or call get_purchase with it; never go back to a call without the receipt once you may have paid. The proxy is rented after ipvolt has confirmed the payment on chain, usually within a few minutes: call get_purchase with the receipt, and never pay again while it is being confirmed. The official x402 clients refuse payments above $1.00 until the wallet's owner raises their limit. At most 6 purchases an hour and 20 a day per network (assistants of one vendor may share a network). acceptTerms accepts the Terms and the Acceptable Use Policy for whoever the purchase is for; the current termsVersion is "2026-11-05".

acceptTerms.description: true: the Terms and the Acceptable Use Policy are accepted for whoever the purchase is for.

receipt.description: Leave out for a quote. On every call after it: the receipt of your own quote, copied exactly. Required with a payment. A secret.

termsVersion.description: The Terms version that is accepted, as the description of this tool and how_to_buy name it.
